name: Tachibana Ryoji
source: The protagonist of the story. He possesses the "Hakidou" (Broken Ghost Eye) in his left eye, which allows him to see through any illusion or supernatural entity. As a result, he is forced to constantly see things he doesn't want to, leading to a fatalistic and world-weary personality beyond his years. He uses his long bangs to cover his left eye in an attempt not to use his ability and avoid trouble. He spends his days indifferently, but his ability allows him to notice Nanase Ouka infiltrating his class, dragging him into various incidents.
